result.title: DT-LoRA: Reaching Beyond the Tangent Space of Low-Rank Adaptation
result.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning. We investigate this performance gap through a tangent-space lens: factorized updates are confined to the tangent space of the current low-rank factors, leaving gradient components outside this space unexploited. An analysis of ten representative LoRA variants reveals that these residual components account for most of the gradient energy and exhibit strong spectral concentration. Motivated by this finding, we propose Dynamic Tangent LoRA (DT-LoRA), which partitions a fixed rank budget into a stable branch and a dynamic branch to capture the principal residual gradient directions. We show that these directions define the optimal update of a local quadratic model under orthogonal-complement and rank constraints. Matrix-free randomized SVD recovers them without materializing the residual gradient, while controlled write-back preserves accumulated updates and stabilizes training within the allocated rank. DT-LoRA adds no trainable parameters or inference cost over LoRA. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over LoRA and its variants. Moreover, despite being a general-purpose adaptation method, DT-LoRA outperforms task-specific approaches to open-vocabulary domain generalization for semantic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://github.com/Snipine/DT-LoRA.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从切线空间角度分析 LoRA 更新受限问题，发现残差梯度分量占能量主体且谱集中，据此提出 DT-LoRA：将固定秩预算划分为稳定与动态分支，用免矩阵随机 SVD 捕捉主残差方向，且不增加可训练参数或推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于参数高效微调与优化几何，讨论的是适配权重的秩约束与梯度方向，未涉及多模态推理的内部状态、视觉证据使用或生成与停止决策，也缺乏可供核查的 latent 状态线索，故排除。
